claims.statement: A correction-only pull request can now pass the validate job, and EVIDENCE_BINDING.md no longer names Rebase and merge as safe for receipts. VERIFIED by replaying this branch with a forced rebase onto main at 7c1061ba8867fdce4d903adc7c9589016e3ab002: head c4411dcfb146 became c8f01aefe70e, every subject SHA changed, and validate_evidence_receipts.py failed with 'subject commit must be an ancestor of checked-out HEAD' as it does after a squash; a local rebase when the base has not moved fast-forwards instead, which is why the hazard is easy to miss. VERIFIED by replaying a correction-only range, a single commit adding one zero-diff retracted receipt onto that same main: the coverage step reported 'Evidence binding passed: 49 receipts' while the candidate-emission step exited non-zero, so the validate job failed for a range coverage accepts. The failure predates the generator change; at main's generator the same call was rejected by argparse. VERIFIED at this commit: the guarded step exits 0 emitting no candidate, the new test executes the step's own shell body and was observed to fail with the guard removed, 184 tests pass under Python 3.12, and scripts/validate.sh reports all executed checks passed. UNKNOWN: whether GitHub's Rebase and merge rewrites commits in every case, which could not be read from docs.github.com because network egress to it is blocked here; the forced-replay reproduction and the cost of being wrong are why the document recommends only the merge commit.
